# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 2.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 2.1   | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues,
discussions, or pull requests.

Instead, use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:
https://github.com/thomas4019/expressa/security/advisories/new

If that is unavailable, email th4019@gmail.com with the subject line
"SECURITY: <short summary>".

Please include: affected version(s), a description of the issue, steps to
reproduce, and the impact you believe it has.
